skill.name: learn-reset
skill.description: Reset a local knowledge base by clearing learned patterns, quirks, decisions, cache, session context, and learning state after confirmation.
skill.summary: Reset saved learning data and state for a fresh knowledge base.
skill.author: 0xrdan

security_audit.summary: All 13 static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code spans and fenced examples in SKILL.md. The skill does not contain executable Ruby or shell commands, but it intentionally directs destructive local file edits to reset saved knowledge, so confirmation and backup guidance are important.

remediation.issue: Destructive reset can cause irreversible local data loss.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation that lists each file and recommend checking backups or git status before clearing content.

remediation.issue: Reset scope is documented but not machine-enforced in the skill text.
remediation.suggestion: Constrain instructions to the named knowledge files and refuse requests to expand the reset outside that directory.

content.value_statement: Old learning data can make assistant behavior stale or misleading. This skill clears saved learnings, cache data, session context, and state after confirmation.
actual_capabilities: Prompts the assistant to confirm before clearing knowledge data.
Clears entries from patterns, quirks, and decisions learning files.
Clears the classification cache and session context files.
Resets learning state values such as extraction count and thresholds.
Preserves the knowledge directory structure while emptying stored entries.
limitations: It cannot restore cleared knowledge unless backups or git history exist.
It applies only to the documented knowledge directory layout.
It does not remove prior knowledge from committed repository history.
It depends on the assistant correctly editing local files.

use_cases.title: Clear Test Learnings
use_cases.description: Reset experimental learning data after validating a knowledge extraction workflow.

use_cases.title: Start a Clean Session
use_cases.description: Remove stale saved patterns before beginning work in a changed project.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Shared Template
use_cases.description: Empty local knowledge files before sharing a starter workspace with teammates.

prompt_templates.title: Reset With Confirmation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use learn-reset to clear my knowledge base. Show the files you will reset and ask for confirmation before changing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Reset Impact
prompt_templates.prompt: Before running learn-reset, inspect the knowledge files and summarize what will be cleared. Do not modify files until I confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Reset Workspace Knowledge
prompt_templates.prompt: Run learn-reset for this workspace only. Preserve directory structure, reset learning state, and report counts for cleared patterns, quirks, decisions, and cache entries.

prompt_templates.title: Audited Reset Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a cautious learn-reset. First check git status, ask for explicit approval, recommend backups, reset documented files, and verify the final state.

output_examples.input: User asks to reset all accumulated learning data.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for confirmation, clears documented learning files after approval, resets cache and state, then reports cleared item counts.

output_examples.input: User requests a reset preview before making changes.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists the affected knowledge files, explains that the action is irreversible, and waits for approval.

output_examples.input: User wants a fresh learning state for a new project.
output_examples.output: The assistant resets saved project knowledge while keeping the folder layout, then confirms learning mode is disabled.

best_practices: Review the affected file list before approving a reset.
Keep backups or git commits when knowledge data may be needed later.
Use the skill only when stale learnings are causing real confusion.
anti_patterns: Do not run the reset without explicit user confirmation.
Do not use it to hide sensitive data that remains in git history.
Do not apply it to unrelated project files or directories.

faq.question: What does this skill reset?
faq.answer: It resets learned patterns, quirks, decisions, classification cache, session context, and learning state files.

faq.question: Does it delete the knowledge folder?
faq.answer: No. The skill says to preserve the directory structure and clear stored entries.

faq.question: Can I undo a reset?
faq.answer: Only if you have backups or useful git history. The skill warns that the action cannot be undone.

faq.question: Should the assistant ask before resetting?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explicitly requires confirmation before any destructive change.

faq.question: Will this remove committed knowledge from git history?
faq.answer: No. The skill notes that old knowledge may still exist in repository history.

faq.question: Can it reset other project files?
faq.answer: No. Its documented scope is limited to the listed knowledge files and state file.
